_help: Settings for AI images, video clips and voice-over made with WanGP (https://github.com/deepbeepmeep/Wan2GP).
The editor copies this file to generation.json on first use; edit generation.json (the app also saves your choices there).
wangp.folder: the WanGP folder (where wgp.py is). wangp.python: WanGP's own Python, e.g. C:\Users\you\miniconda3\envs\wan2gp\python.exe (in a terminal: conda activate wan2gp, then: where python).
Each tier points to a settings file you export from WanGP: pick the model and settings in WanGP, click 'Export Settings', save the file in the templates folder, and put its name in 'template'.
overrides may only change: resolution (e.g. "480x832"), num_inference_steps, video_length (frames, or seconds like "3s"), duration_seconds.
vram_gb: your estimate of the VRAM a tier needs, if you know it (shown in the app; null = unknown).
default_tier: chosen in the app after Compare. pinned_tier: always use this tier instead of choosing automatically.
limits: per video. max_generation_minutes: all AI generation for one video; max_ai_clips: AI images/clips per video; job_timeout_minutes: one job.
The editor never downloads models: download them in WanGP, after reading each model's license.
